channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE divulga distribuição do tempo de propaganda eleitoral gratuita para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) released the party and federation representativity table for allocating free electoral advertising time on radio and TV and participation in debates for the 2026 elections. The União Progressista Federation (União Brasil and PP) leads with 104 federal deputies, followed by the PL (98) and the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB and PV) with 81. The criteria are based on Constitutional Amendment No. 97/2017 and TSE Resolutions No. 23.610/2019 and 23.671/2021.

item.title: Polícia Civil investiga suspeitos de planejar ataques durante eleições no Brasil
item.description: The Civil Police of the Federal District launched an operation on Tuesday (4) to investigate suspects allegedly planning attacks in Brasília during the October municipal elections. The action aims to assess threats to the security of the electoral process in the federal capital.

item.title: Flávio promete voucher para acesso a creche e “tratar internet como infraestrutura”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, pledged to implement a voucher system for daycare access, treat internet as infrastructure, and launch a program to help young people start businesses. The remarks were made during a sabatina with O Antagonista and G4.

item.title: g1 e GloboNews entrevistam nesta quinta-feira (6) Romeu Zema, candidato à Presidência da República
item.description: G1 and GloboNews will interview Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, on Thursday (6). He is the second interviewee in the series, following Renan Santos (Wednesday) and preceding Ronaldo Caiado (Friday). Lula declined the invitation, while Flávio Bolsonaro has not yet responded.

item.title: g1 e GloboNews entrevistam nesta quarta-feira (5) Renan Santos, candidato à Presidência da República
item.description: Renan Santos, the presidential candidate from the Missão party, launches a series of interviews on g1 and GloboNews this Wednesday (5), followed by Romeu Zema (6) and Ronaldo Caiado (7). Lula declined to participate, while Flávio Bolsonaro has not yet confirmed his attendance for the scheduled interview on Monday (10). The initiative aims to deepen the electoral debate with the main presidential contenders for 2026.

item.title: Seminarista integra grupo que planejava atentado sangrento em Brasília
item.description: A Pernambuco seminarian was targeted in Operation Rede Interrompida by the PCDF for alleged participation in a group planning a violent attack in Brasília during the 2026 elections. Investigations revealed discussions on building invasions, target selection, sharing of architectural plans, and explosive manuals. The inquiry is probing charges of criminal association, incitement to crime, and apology.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que dosimetria virou “esculhambação” e promete mudança no STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, criticized the debate over sentencing for those involved in the January 8 acts, calling it a 'mess', and promised to change the relationship between the Branches of Government in a potential administration, during an interview with O Antagonista.

item.title: Dino manda abrir investigação sobre Lulinha como vítima de vazamento
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino authorized the opening of a fourth investigation involving Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha), this time positioning him as a victim of alleged leaks of confidential data from ongoing investigations. The move responds to a Federal Police request to investigate the unauthorized disclosure of information tied to the 'Farra do INSS' case. Lulinha is already under investigation in three separate cases for alleged influence peddling, corruption, and fraud related to contracts with INSS, Dataprev, and the Ministry of Health, all tied to his alleged use of influence as the son of President Lula.

item.title: Realtime: 45% acham que quarto mandato de Lula seria o pior
item.description: A Realtime Big Data poll, published by O Antagonista, found that 45% of voters believe a fourth term for President Lula would be the worst of all, while 31% think it would be the same as previous terms and 24% believe it would be the best. The survey also examined other topics, though specific details were not included in the excerpt.

item.title: PL monta chapa ‘puro-sangue’ no Rio após perder apoio do Centrão
item.description: The PL nominated federal deputy Carlos Jordy for the second Senate seat in Rio de Janeiro after the Progressista federation (União Brasil and PP) withdrew from the alliance, leaving the party with no time to recompose its ticket. Senator Carlos Portinho had already been confirmed for reelection, while the gubernatorial candidate is Douglas Ruas, president of the Legislative Assembly, who lost his running mate after former Nova Iguaçu mayor Rogério Lisboa (PP) withdrew. The federation maintained neutrality in both the state and presidential races.

item.title: Republicanos oficializa neutralidade na eleição presidencial e não apoiará Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Republicans party declared neutrality in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election at a national convention, rejecting support for PL pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision, backed by 17 state directories, blocks Flávio’s bid to expand his TV airtime and secure Daniella Marques as his running mate. Party leader Marcos Pereira stated Flávio will find a vice-presidential candidate within the PL and that the Republicans will personally assist his campaign.

item.title: “Se o capeta ajudar a disciplinar as emendas, teremos que conversar”, diz Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's pre-candidate for president in 2026, argued in a sabatina with O Antagonista and G4 that parliamentary amendments need to be disciplined, stating, 'If the devil helps discipline the amendments, we’ll have to talk.' He addressed criticism for praising Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, framing it as part of a broader call for transparency and control over amendment usage. The sabatina marked the first major event of his 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro quebra silêncio sobre influência do pai em eventual governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, stated he would have autonomy to lead a potential government and would make different choices from those of his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. The comment was made during an interview with O Antagonista and G4, in response to questions about familial influence on his future administration.

item.title: Precisarei “montar coalizão com o Congresso e sociedade civil”, diz Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's pre-candidate for president of Brazil, said he will need to build a coalition with Congress and civil society in a potential government, avoiding arriving in Brasília 'insulting others'. The remarks were made during a sabatina by O Antagonista and G4, described as the first major event of the 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: INSS: PF mapeia rota de dinheiro vivo, imóveis e jatos em investigação
item.description: The Federal Police identified in a new phase of Operation Sem Desconto a complex patrimonial movement structure involving cash, high-value real estate, companies, and private aircraft, allegedly used to conceal the origin and destination of resources in the investigated scheme related to the INSS. The decision by Minister André Mendonça of the STF authorized 18 search and seizure warrants in the Federal District and Maranhão after the PF gathered evidence that individuals and legal entities, third-party accounts, and business structures were used to administer and circulate the funds under investigation.

item.title: AGU descarta questionar André Mendonça e busca diálogo para estancar crise com PF
item.description: The Attorney General’s Office (AGU) has decided not to appeal the order by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça requiring the Federal Police to hand over raw documents from the INSS investigation and maintain the investigative team. Minister Jorge Messias aims to resolve the standoff through dialogue, proposing a meeting between Mendonça and Justice Minister Wellington César to prevent accusations of obstruction of justice. The PF views the order as infringing on its investigative autonomy, while the government fears legal challenges could invalidate the operation, similar to how Lula’s convictions were overturned in the Lava Jato case.

item.title: Renan Santos defende “direito penal voltado para a vítima”
item.description: Renan Santos, the Mission party's pre-candidate for president of Brazil, defended in a sabatina with O Antagonista and G4 the adoption of a victim-centered criminal law, arguing that the concept of imprisonment and punishment needs to be reoriented. He noted that the sabatina marked the first major event of the 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: 'Já me viram envolvido com rachadinha? Mensalão?', diz Caiado em referência a casos de corrupção que citam Flávio Bolsonaro e PT
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, questioned whether he had ever been linked to corruption cases like 'rachadinha' or the mensalão during a sabatina by 'O Antagonista', citing scandals involving the PT and PL parties. He also commented on investigations against Lulinha, President Lula’s son, saying 'the prince’s scandal has already reached the king’s antechamber,' and advocated for tougher public security policies, lowering the age of criminal responsibility, and pardoning those convicted for the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Chefe da campanha de Flávio pede ao TCU suspensão de contrato do STF sobre menções online à corte
item.description: The coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), has requested the TCU to suspend the STF's contract with a company tasked with monitoring online mentions of the Court, citing potential overspending and threats to freedom of expression. The move comes amid rising tensions between the Judiciary and allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro over the role of institutions in regulating online content.

item.title: Conheça os procedimentos que garantem o encerramento seguro das eleições
item.description: After the official voting closes at 5 p.m., anyone already in line is guaranteed the right to vote and receives a service ticket. The last two voters to cast their ballots are invited to observe the closing procedures, including the printing of the Ballot Bulletin, and receive an official copy of the results. These steps, outlined in TSE Resolution No. 23.751/2026, ensure transparency, security, and regularity, with political parties allowed to monitor the process.

item.title: TSE manda retirar publicações com promoção pessoal de Lula dos canais oficiais do governo
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the federal government to remove from official channels content that could constitute personal promotion of President Lula during the institutional propaganda blackout period, allowing only strictly informative posts. The ruling also requires Facebook and X to remove such content within 24 hours, regardless of government compliance, in accordance with electoral law restricting institutional advertising three months before elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda remover em 24h postagens oficiais que destaquem figura de Lula
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques ordered the removal within 24 hours of official government social media posts that highlight President Lula’s personal figure, deeming it an improper use of public resources during the electoral period. The ruling also bans new such posts and requires Facebook and X to make the content unavailable, regardless of Secom’s action. The decision partially grants a PL request alleging unlawful electoral advantage via government propaganda.

item.title: Renan Santos quer “desfavelização” com parceria entre governo e iniciativa privada
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, proposed a 'defavelaization' plan to transform precarious urban communities into areas with infrastructure, property regularization, and improved access to essential services. The initiative relies on a partnership between government and the private sector. The proposal was announced during a sabatina with O Antagonista and G4 on March 4.

item.title: MP de SP confirma que Renan Santos foi absolvido em processo por acusação de estupro
item.description: The São Paulo Public Ministry confirmed that Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, was acquitted due to insufficient evidence in a rape case tried under judicial secrecy. The prosecution had initially charged Santos but, after the evidentiary phase, requested acquittal owing to lack of sufficient proof. The confirmation came after g1 obtained the case number, which had previously been unavailable due to redacted documents submitted by the defense.

item.title: Dino autoriza nova investigação sobre Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino authorized the Federal Police to launch a third investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, over allegations of influence peddling benefiting partner companies within the federal government. The order was issued on Tuesday, the 4th, and concerns potential improper advantages granted by the son of President Lula.

item.title: Dino autoriza abertura do terceiro inquérito envolvendo Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino authorized a third investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) over alleged illicit business dealings in federal government areas, plus a fourth probe into leaks of confidential information. Lulinha’s defense welcomed the move calmly, expressing trust in Dino and denying any wrongdoing, while accusing selective leaks and potential politicization of the Federal Police by electoral interests.

item.title: Suplício de usuários de trens encolhe circo privatista de SP
item.description: The article criticizes the privatization of public transportation services in São Paulo, arguing that selling essential services to private companies has worsened the quality of transit for users rather than improving it. Using the metaphor of a circus, it suggests that, contrary to what Governor Tarcísio de Freitas aims to demonstrate, privatization does not expand services but shrinks them, making them more precarious and burdensome for the population.

item.title: Zema promete acabar com sigilos e ampliar transparência no governo
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party’s presidential candidate, pledged to end government secrecy and increase transparency in public administration, stating he will make his expenses and official commitments public and demand the same from all public officials. He criticized the federal government’s overuse of secrecy and positioned himself as a defender of accountability and access to information.

item.title: Zema promete não aumentar impostos e cortar gastos públicos
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, promised not to raise taxes and to cut public spending if elected. He emphasized that his administration will prioritize fiscal balance without resorting to new taxes. The statement was made during a sabatina by O Antagonista and G4, the first in a series of interviews.

item.title: Vou defender que “tudo seja investigado, doa a quem doer”, afirma Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for President of Brazil, stated in a sabatina with O Antagonista and G4 that he has 'nothing to hide' and will defend that all investigations be carried out, regardless of who is affected, in a potential government. The remark was made during the first major event of his 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Ex-assessor de Lula diz que dinheiro recebido de amiga de Lulinha foi empréstimo
item.description: Former Chief of Staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), admitted receiving money from Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha under PF investigation, but claimed it was a personal loan already repaid and denied any illegality. The transaction, reported by Poder360, occurred during his tenure and raises suspicions of influence peddling tied to the 'Careca do INSS' scandal.

item.title: TSE manda governo remover publicações com destaque pessoal a Lula em canais oficiais
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the federal government to remove posts on official channels that promote the personal actions of President Lula, a reelection candidate, during the electoral period. The decision aims to prevent institutional content from becoming prohibited personal campaigning under electoral law, also requiring platforms like Facebook and X to remove such posts within 24 hours.

item.title: “Sou totalmente contrário ao toma lá, dá cá, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president of Brazil, stated he is totally opposed to 'quid pro quo' politics — the exchange of favors between the Executive and Legislative branches — during a sabatina hosted by O Antagonista and G4. This marks the first major event of his presidential campaign, underscoring his stance against corruption and political patronage in Brazil.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 52% e desaprovado por 47% no Pará, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data conducted between July 30 and August 3, 2026, in Pará shows that 52% of voters approve of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s government, while 47% disapprove. Regarding performance evaluation, 42% rated the government as excellent or good, 22% as regular, and 35% as bad or terrible. The poll interviewed 1,600 people aged 16 or older, with a 2-percentage-point margin of error and registration at the TSE under code BR-09650/2026.

item.title: PL já tem nome escalado para substituir Canella na disputa ao Senado no Rio
item.description: Deputy Carlos Jordy (PL) is expected to be launched as the Senate candidate for Rio de Janeiro following the withdrawal of Márcio Canella (União Brasil), who opted to run for the state Legislative Assembly. Canella announced his withdrawal in a social media video, citing his recent arrest for illegal firearm possession and the distancing of the União-PP federation from Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign. The PL aims to have two Senate candidates in the state, as Carlos Portinho already holds one seat.

item.title: Lula tem 45% contra 36% de Flávio no 2º turno no Pará, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll shows President Lula leading with 45% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 36% in a potential runoff in Pará. In the first round, the incumbent also holds a lead with 43% of voting intentions compared to 33% for the senator.

item.title: Ídolo do São Paulo, Luis Fabiano se declara assexual em candidatura
item.description: Luis Fabiano, former São Paulo striker and MDB pre-candidate for federal deputy in 2026, had his sexual orientation mistakenly recorded as 'asexual' in the electoral registry, according to the party, which said it will correct the error. He announced his candidacy in May, emphasizing his goal to transform the future of youth and Brazilian cities, and declared assets worth R$20 million and 27 properties.

item.title: Sem paz e amor, Lula promete gestão porreta e mira vitória no 1º turno
item.description: Lula confirmed his 2026 re-election bid under the PT, stating he has definitively moved past the "Lulinha paz e amor" image to adopt a firmer, more confrontational stance. He promised a "porreta" fourth term marked by bold decisions and willingness to challenge the opposition, aiming to win in the first round. Noblat’s analysis underscores Lula’s determination to conclude his presidential trajectory with a decisive victory.

item.title: PT aciona Nikolas Ferreira na Justiça por propaganda antecipada negativa contra Lula
item.description: Federal Deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) filed a formal complaint with the General Prosecutor's Office (PGR) against Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) for negative anticipatory electoral propaganda against President Lula. The move comes ahead of the 2026 elections, with the PT alleging that Ferreira disseminated harmful content before the legally permitted campaign period.

item.title: Lula soube há duas semanas do empréstimo de lobista de Careca do INSS a seu assessor
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva learned two weeks ago about a loan obtained by Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as 'Marcola', his former chief of staff, from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger of the INSS. According to sources close to the president, Lula felt 'sad' and 'disappointed' by the revelation. The exclusive report highlights a potential conflict of interest involving a senior aide.

item.title: Visitas a Lula em Curitiba, controle da agenda e empréstimo na mira da PF: saiba quem é Marcola, ex-chefe de gabinete do presidente
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, served as Chief of Staff to President Lula until July 2024 and maintained direct access to the president for years, including during Lula’s imprisonment in Curitiba. He received a loan from Roberta Luchsinger, a businesswoman under investigation by the Federal Police for alleged participation in INSS fraud schemes and a friend of the president’s son, Lulinha. His move from chief of staff to the campaign team has raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest and influence over the presidential agenda.

item.title: Lula indica Antônio Carlos Berwanger para diretoria da CVM
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has nominated Antônio Carlos Berwanger for a director position at the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM), with the formal submission to the Senate published in the Official Gazette on August 4, 2026. Berwanger, who has led the CVM’s Market Development Superintendency since 2015, brings extensive experience in capital markets regulation, including oversight of the regulatory sandbox and the Experimentation Laboratory. He holds degrees in Economics and Law, a master’s in Regulatory Law from FGV, and a specialization in Fintechs and Regulatory Innovation from the University of Cambridge.

item.title: Ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula admite ter recebido empréstimo de amiga de Lulinha investigada pela PF
item.description: Former chief of staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, admitted receiving a personal loan from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who is under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected influence peddling involving Lula’s eldest son, Lulinha. Ribeiro stated the loan was personal and already repaid, but the PF cites the transaction in requests to open inquiries into whether it constituted a bribe to gain access to government offices, including the Ministry of Health and the Presidential Palace. Luchsinger allegedly made over 40 unregistered visits to federal agencies between 2023 and 2025, often accompanied by businessman Antônio Camilo Antunes (‘Careca do INSS’), with suspected backing from Lulinha.

item.title: Universalizar escola em tempo integral custaria R$ 170 bilhões e desafia espaço fiscal de Lula
item.description: Universalizing full-time schooling in Brazil would cost R$ 170 billion over 10 years, according to a proposal under discussion for Lula’s government program. The figure poses a significant challenge to the administration’s fiscal space, requiring budget adjustments or new revenue sources. While educationally beneficial, the measure strains public finances amid a context of spending restraint.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e aliados usam empréstimo de empresária alvo no caso INSS a ex-assessor de Lula para desgastar presidente
item.description: Opposition lawmakers, led by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), criticized the Lula government after reports revealed that former Chief of the Personal Presidency Office, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), received a personal loan from businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, who is under PF investigation linked to the 'INSS Careca' scheme. The opposition claims the loan indicates the infiltration of alleged INSS fraud into the presidential office, though Marcola stated the loan was personal, already repaid, and unrelated to his official duties.

item.title: Dinheiro para auxiliar de Lula eleva radiatividade de Lulinha
item.description: The Lulinha case, involving President Lula's son, gained prominence after the discovery of a financial link between his friend Roberta Luchsinger, an INSS lobbyist, and Marco Aurélio Ribeiro, a Lula aide known as Marcola. Suspicions arise that this relationship was used to facilitate government contracts, raising concerns about influence peddling and corruption.

item.title: Investigações das fraudes do INSS causam estragos em personagens próximos a Lula e Flávio
item.description: Investigations into INSS fraud are causing political damage to figures close to Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, affecting indistinctly the leading presidential candidates in 2026. The scandal, revealed in an exclusive subscriber-only report, exposes a climate of instability that could undermine support bases on both ends of the political spectrum.

item.title: Farra do INSS: advogado alvo da PF é “amigo” de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police launched a new phase of Operation Sem Desconto, investigating the so-called 'INSS Party', executing 18 search and seizure warrants authorized by the STF. Among the targets is lawyer Willer Tomaz, a personal friend of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), whom Bolsonaro publicly called 'my friend' during the 2021 Senate Covid CPI and traveled with to Florida in 2025 aboard a jet owned by the proprietors of União Química laboratory. Relatives of Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) are also targeted.

item.title: Nikolas lamenta desistência de Cleitinho: "PL apostava as fichas nele"
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira regretted Cleitinho Azevedo's withdrawal from the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race, stating that the Liberal Party had placed its hopes on his candidacy. He acknowledged Cleitinho's reasons tied to mourning his brother's death and said the PL will decide by Wednesday (August 5) its electoral path, awaiting national leadership guidance from figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Marinho.

item.title: Senador Weverton Rocha é alvo de operação da PF que apura fraudes no INSS
item.description: Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) is a target of a Federal Police operation investigating suspected money laundering within Operation Sem Desconto, which probes improper discounts against INSS retirees and pensioners. The operation executes 18 search and seizure warrants in the Federal District and Maranhão, also targeting lawyer Willer Tomaz, close to Flávio Bolsonaro, and other politicians. The PF has concluded one inquiry related to Conafer, indicting former INSS presidents and others for corruption, criminal organization, and pension fraud.
